clue.text: Quiet region of Spain, one that's just perfect

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for playing quietly
Aragon is a region of north-east Spain

explanation.surface: Somewhere quiet in Spain is held up as simply perfect.
explanation.definitionFit: A paragon is a model of excellence, someone who seems flawless.

clue.text: Truce after weapon destroyed cities

parts.note: an arm is a weapon, as in firearms

indicators.note: the cities are wrecked, so their letters are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Peace is called once the weapons have flattened the cities.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'after' as 'once the war is over', but it only links definition to wordplay; 'destroyed' wrecks the cities into ISTICE.
explanation.definitionFit: An armistice is an agreement to stop fighting, a formal truce.

clue.text: Unmentionable things zombie does?

definitions.meaning: a zombie is one of the undead

explanation.definitionFit: Undies is a casual word for underwear, the garments politely termed unmentionables.

clue.text: By end of over I had ball causing dismissal

indicators.note: the end of the word over is its final letter

parts.note: contracted, I had is I'd
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A cricket ball bowled at the end of an over gets the batsman out.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture (over, ball, dismissal) misleads: the ball is a dance and the dismissal is getting rid of someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Riddance is the act of getting rid of someone, a sending away or dismissal.

clue.text: Three men get coin to go round one famous golf course

parts.note: Roy, Alan and Dan are three men's names
Alan is the second name
Dan is the third name

indicators.note: the coin is placed around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a cent is a coin
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Three golfers chip in a coin each to play a round at a famous club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go round' puts I inside CENT, giving CIENT; 'get' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The Royal and Ancient is the golf club at St Andrews in Scotland, a famous home of golf, often used to mean its Old Course.

clue.text: Find record finished

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
over means finished

explanation.surface: Someone finds that the record has run to its end.
explanation.definitionFit: To discover something is to find it.

clue.text: Did 'urt with weapons

definitions.meaning: harmed with its H dropped, as the apostrophe in 'urt shows

explanation.definitionFit: Armed means bearing weapons; with the H dropped, Cockney-style, it also passes for harmed.

clue.text: Blade snubbed girl

parts.note: to cut someone is to snub them
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A sharp girl ignores someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutlass is a short curved sword with a single edge, a kind of blade.

clue.text: Dolly has heart turned by regular customer

indicators.note: the heart of the singer's surname is its two central letters, and these are swapped round

parts.note: Dolly Parton is the American country singer

explanation.surface: The singer Dolly finds her heart won over by a loyal customer.
explanation.walkthrough: Turning the central pair RT of PARTON gives TR.
explanation.definitionFit: A patron is a regular client of a shop, bar or restaurant.

clue.text: Area of beauty can produce moist eye

indicators.note: the letters are worked into a new product, which signals rearranging them

explanation.surface: A place of natural beauty can bring a tear to the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: Yosemite is a Californian national park famous for its natural beauty.

clue.text: Church built initially with a quartz material

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of built

parts.note: quartz is a form of silica

explanation.surface: A church was first built using a quartz-based material.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is a large oblong church, often one granted special privileges by the Pope.

clue.text: Suffering two low grades in examination

indicators.note: in places the grades inside the exam

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination
D and E are two poor exam grades

explanation.surface: A student is upset at getting two poor marks in an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a painful experience, a time of suffering.

clue.text: Foreign noblewoman to defraud savings account once

parts.note: to con is to swindle
a TESSA, Tax-Exempt Special Savings Account, was a UK savings scheme of the 1990s

explanation.surface: A foreign aristocrat sets out to swindle someone out of their savings.
explanation.walkthrough: TESSA was a British tax-free savings account, replaced by the ISA in 1999.
explanation.definitionFit: A contessa is an Italian countess, a noblewoman from abroad.

clue.text: Is annoying society without cause

parts.note: to needle someone is to annoy them, so it needles

explanation.surface: Bothering people for no reason at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Needless means unnecessary, lacking any good reason.

clue.text: She cleans Californian city strip

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
to strip is to undress

explanation.surface: Someone cleans a Californian city of its striptease.
explanation.definitionFit: A laundress is a woman who washes clothes and linen.

clue.text: American beach barbecue where Madeleine perhaps eats meat

indicators.note: the cake takes the meat inside it, as if eating it

parts.note: a madeleine is a small sponge cake, so an example of a cake
lamb is a meat

explanation.surface: At a beach barbecue, a girl called Madeleine tucks into some meat.
explanation.walkthrough: Madeleine reads as a girl's name but is a small French cake; 'where' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A clambake is a picnic on the beach in America where seafood is cooked.

clue.text: Shrub, being at home in desert, to become sickly when uprooted

clue.text: Sailor with no company gets seafood

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor
alone means without company

explanation.surface: A lonely sailor finds something to eat from the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Abalone is an edible shellfish, a kind of seafood.

clue.text: Rascal with debts spurning religion

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous rascal
IOUs are written promises to pay debts

explanation.surface: A rascal in debt turns his back on faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Impious means lacking reverence, showing disrespect for faith and the divine.

clue.text: Devil gets handle on familiar address

parts.note: Old Nick is a name for the devil
a handle is slang for a name

explanation.surface: The devil gets a grip on a friendly greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A nickname is an informal name used by people who know you well.

clue.text: Provides West End show entertaining Her Majesty

indicators.note: the show holds the queen within it, as a host entertains a guest

parts.note: Cats is a long-running London West End musical
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: A London musical puts on a show for the Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: The West End is London's theatre district.
explanation.definitionFit: To cater is to provide food or what is needed, so caters means provides.

clue.text: Beat Obama, for example, one after another

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
Barack Obama is a Democrat, abbreviated Dem

explanation.surface: Beating the president in a run of contests.
explanation.definitionFit: In tandem means one behind the other, as on a two-seat bicycle.

clue.text: Condescend to exclude son from plan

indicators.note: excluding the son means taking his letter out

parts.note: a design is a plan

explanation.surface: Someone stoops to leaving their son out of the plans.
explanation.definitionFit: To deign is to lower oneself to do something, to stoop.

clue.text: When school is open football team's back to get together

parts.note: during the school term, in term

indicators.note: back turns the team's numeral around

parts.note: a football team is an eleven, XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: During term time the football team returns to train together.
explanation.definitionFit: To intermix is to mingle, to come together.

clue.text: Cheat friend holding in to keep under control

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat them

indicators.note: the friend holds the other word inside

parts.note: a mate is a friend

explanation.surface: A cheat keeps a friend in so as to control them.
explanation.definitionFit: To dominate is to have power over, to keep in check.

clue.text: Secure after breakout and free from danger

indicators.note: after a break-out the letters are free to scatter and regroup

explanation.surface: Locking up again after a jailbreak, then making things safe.
explanation.definitionFit: To rescue someone is to save them from harm.

clue.text: Control opening to create in new form

parts.note: to rein something in is to control it
a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: Controlling an opening so as to make something new.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinvent something is to remake it in a different way.
